subway: Closed subway transfer station, broad matte blue-grey asphalt, purple gate with tiny warm lamps, left edge old muted indigo train silhouettes, right edge occasional muted red conduit and grates, steel profiles. No rails crossing the lane.
museum: Museum after closing, muted deep blue-green dark slate play floor, small black and cyan portal in cracked stone, left framed canvases and right storage crates as sparse edge silhouettes.
cartenon: Cartenon temple, matte muted slate-navy play floor, icy pale blue portal in a simple low stone arch, edge carved blocks, two kneeling reliefs and sparse blue lamps.
demon-castle: Demon Castle ash street, broad matte dark umber paving tone, restrained charcoal reddish shadows, glowing orange portal in a low stone arch, small burnt pillars and sparse cinders at the edges.
jeju-hive: Jeju ant hive, broad flattened warm charcoal-brown packed earth, golden amber gate in low cave rock, a few chunky striated basalt silhouettes and tiny ochre mineral tips along edges. No living insects or eggs in the play lane.
red-knight: Red Knight dungeon, broad matte dusty indigo-purple play floor, compact crimson portal in low gothic iron arch, side pillars and burgundy cloth pennants in big stepped blocks with restrained reds.
